question: Which state is famous for celebrating the Pongal festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pongal** is a major festival celebrated in the state of **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• The festival is dedicated to the Sun God and marks the beginning of the Tamil month of **Thai**.
 
• Pongal is a four-day festival, with each day having its own significance and rituals.
 
• The festival is celebrated with the preparation of a special dish called **Pongal**, which is made from newly harvested rice, milk, and jaggery.
 
• Pongal signifies the end of the winter solstice and the start of the sun's six-month-long journey northwards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The festival is similar to Makar Sankranti celebrated in other parts of India.
 
• Pongal is also a time for family reunions and gatherings, with people wearing new clothes and decorating their homes with kolam (rangoli).
 
• The four days of Pongal are known as Bhogi Pongal, Surya Pongal, Mattu Pongal, and Kaanum Pongal.
 
• On Mattu Pongal, cattle are worshipped and adorned with colorful decorations as a mark of gratitude for their help in farming.
 
• Pongal is not only celebrated in Tamil Nadu but also by Tamilians worldwide.
